remarks: Gorgeous Renovated 2-Bedroom in the Heart of Downtown Greenwich Conveniently located in the vibrant heart of downtown Greenwich, this recently refreshed two-bedroom condo offers both style and convenience. Newly refinished hardwood floors throughout, newer A/C units, and stainless steel appliances. With arched doorways, an updated kitchen, and a cozy fireplace, every detail has been thoughtfully designed for comfortable living. Just moments from Greenwich Avenue's premier shopping, dining, and the train station, you'll enjoy the ultimate in-town lifestyle. This unit includes a reserved parking spot and storage space making this downtown gem an unbeatable opportunity for hassle-free living!
